ai_positioning.summary: La société n'a pas mentionné l'intelligence artificielle, l'apprentissage automatique ou des technologies similaires dans les extraits fournis de son rapport 10-K/20-F. Par conséquent, sa position sur l'IA ne peut être déterminée à partir de ces informations.
evidence: LyondellBasell n'expose aucune mention significative d'IA/machine learning dans son dernier rapport annuel : la valeur se lit prioritairement sur les fondamentaux propres au secteur (chimie et polymeres).

Les KPIs operationnels et financiers de la fiche restent les meilleurs indicateurs de qualite d'investissement pour cette ste ; un usage interne d'IA pourra etre trace en V2.0 des qu'il sera divulgue explicitement.

risks.title: Infractions environnementales et sanctions réglementaires
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in Item 1A, the company faces ongoing environmental proceedings in Texas (Clean Air Act violations) and Illinois (air exceedances), with proposed orders and civil penalties. However, management states belief that none will be material to financial statements, suggesting moderate severity rather than critical. Citation: "Securities and Exchange Commission rules require disclosure of certain environmental matters when a governmental authority". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: LyondellBasell faces multiple environmental proceedings and inquiries from U.S. authorities regarding alleged violations of environmental laws, with potential civil penalties and injunctive relief, primarily related to air emissions at facilities in Texas, Louisiana and Illinois.

risks.title: Ralentissement des marchés pétrochimiques et surcapacité
risks.score_rationale: Described as significant headwinds in Item 7 MD&A, the petrochemical downturn directly caused the 10% revenue decline and major segment margin compression. The impact on 2025 results and expected European asset losses ($700-900M) indicates critical severity. Citation: "Throughout 2025, petrochemical markets faced significant headwinds from global trade disruptions, falling oil prices and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Global petrochemical markets face significant headwinds from trade disruptions, falling oil prices, and capacity additions outpacing demand, resulting in lower average selling prices, reduced margins, and pressure on all major segments.
risks.title_en: Downturn in petrochemical markets and capacity oversupply

risks.title: Significant asset impairment charges
risks.score_rationale: In Q3 2025, the company recognized 1,182M$ in non-cash impairments (972M$ goodwill + 279M$ PP&E) in O&P-EAI and APS segments due to prolonged industry downturn and sustained decline in market capitalization. These charges directly turned operating income negative. Citation: "During 2025, we permanently closed our European PO Joint Venture incurring $126 million of shutdown". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: LyondellBasell recorded substantial non-cash impairment charges of 1,251M$ in 2025 across European and advanced polymer segments, reflecting the prolonged downturn in petrochemical and automotive industries, combined with sustained market capitalization decline.

risks.title: Concurrence à l’import et pression sur les marges
risks.score_rationale: Documented in MD&A as driving factor in O&P-EAI and O&P-Americas segments, with specific mention of import competition in O&P-EAI reducing polymer margins. Impact is quantifiable but non-catastrophic, hence moderate severity. Citation: "In our O P-EAI segment, polymer margins declined throughout 2025 due to competition from imports". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Import competition and well-supplied markets are compressing margins in polyethylene and polyolefins segments, particularly affecting the O&P-Americas and O&P-EAI business units.

risks.title: Perte attendue sur la cession d’actifs européens d’oléfines et de polyoléfines
risks.score_rationale: Announced in 2025 with expected close Q2 2026, the company will recognize a loss of approximately 700-900M$ on the sale of European O&P assets, including 300M$ cash contribution. This material non-recurring loss impacts shareholder value significantly. Citation: "During 2024, we recognized an $837 million non-cash impairment of property, plant and equipment related". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: LyondellBasell agreed to sell certain European olefins and polyolefins assets and business, with an expected loss of 700-900M$ upon closing in Q2 2026, including a 300M$ cash contribution prior to closing.
risks.title_en: Expected loss on sale of European olefins and polyolefins assets

risks.title: Volatilité des coûts des matières premières et de l’énergie
risks.score_rationale: MD&A notes feedstock and energy costs represent approximately 70% of total cost of sales. While 2025 benefited from lower feedstock and energy costs (contributing to COGS reduction), future volatility could reverse these gains. Citation: "The related operating results of our refining business are reported as discontinued operations for all". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in feedstock and energy costs, which represent approximately 70% of annual cost of sales, create volatility in profitability and are a significant operational variable beyond company control.
risks.title_en: Volatility in feedstock and energy costs

company_description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. operates as a chemical company in the United States, Germany, China, Mexico, Italy, Japan, France, Poland, the Netherlands, and internationally. It operates in five segments: Olefins and PolyolefinsAmericas; Olefins and PolyolefinsEurope, Asia, International; Intermediates and Derivatives; Advanced Polymer Solutions; and Technology. The company produces and markets olefins and co-products, such as ethylene, aromatics, propylene and butadiene; polyolefins; polyethylene; polypropylene homopolymers and copolymers; propylene oxide and derivatives; oxyfuels and related products; and intermediate chemicals, such as styrene monomer and acetyls. It also produces and markets compounding and solutions, including polypropylene compounds, engineered plastics, masterbatches, and engineered composites and colors. In addition, it develops and licenses chemical and polyolefin process technologies; and manufactures and sells polyolefin catalysts and serves food packaging, home furnishings, automotive components, and paints and coatings applications. LyondellBasell Industries N.V. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

enrich_risks._source: Existing risks FR translation + EN preserved (batch 2/4 final FR)

risks.title: Infractions environnementales et sanctions réglementaires
risks.score_rationale: Divulgué en Item 1A, la société fait face à des procédures environnementales en cours au Texas (violations du Clean Air Act) et dans l'Illinois (dépassements atmosphériques), avec des ordonnances proposées et des pénalités civiles. La direction estime cependant qu'aucune ne sera significative pour les états financiers, ce qui suggère une sévérité modérée plutôt que critique. Citation: "Additional risks from our multinational business include transportation delays and interruptions, war, terrorist activities, epidemics"
risks.summary: LyondellBasell fait face à plusieurs procédures et enquêtes environnementales d'autorités américaines portant sur des violations alléguées des lois environnementales, avec des pénalités civiles et mesures correctives potentielles, principalement liées aux émissions atmosphériques sur des sites au Texas, en Louisiane et dans l'Illinois.
risks.summary_en: LyondellBasell faces multiple environmental proceedings and inquiries from U.S. authorities regarding alleged violations of environmental laws, with potential civil penalties and injunctive relief, primarily related to air emissions at facilities in Texas, Louisiana and Illinois.
risks.score_rationale_en: Disclosed in Item 1A, the company faces ongoing environmental proceedings in Texas (Clean Air Act violations) and Illinois (air exceedances), with proposed orders and civil penalties. However, management states belief that none will be material to financial statements, suggesting moderate severity rather than critical.

risks.title: Repli des marchés pétrochimiques et surcapacité
risks.score_rationale: Décrit comme des vents contraires majeurs en Item 7 MD&A, le repli pétrochimique a directement causé la baisse de 10% des revenus et la compression majeure des marges segmentaires. L'impact sur les résultats 2025 et les pertes attendues sur les actifs européens (700-900 M$) indique une sévérité critique. Citation: "We sell products in highly competitive global markets and face significant price pressures"
risks.summary: Les marchés mondiaux de la pétrochimie font face à des vents contraires importants liés aux perturbations commerciales, à la baisse des prix du pétrole et à des ajouts de capacité dépassant la demande, entraînant une baisse des prix de vente moyens, une compression des marges et une pression sur tous les segments majeurs.
risks.title_en: Downturn in petrochemical markets and capacity oversupply
risks.summary_en: Global petrochemical markets face significant headwinds from trade disruptions, falling oil prices, and capacity additions outpacing demand, resulting in lower average selling prices, reduced margins, and pressure on all major segments.
risks.score_rationale_en: Described as significant headwinds in Item 7 MD&A, the petrochemical downturn directly caused the 10% revenue decline and major segment margin compression. The impact on 2025 results and expected European asset losses ($700-900M) indicates critical severity.

risks.title: Charges de dépréciation d'actifs significatives
risks.score_rationale: Au T3 2025, la société a constaté 1 182 M$ de dépréciations hors trésorerie (972 M$ goodwill + 279 M$ immobilisations) dans les segments O&P-EAI et APS en raison du repli sectoriel prolongé et de la baisse soutenue de la capitalisation. Ces charges ont directement fait basculer le résultat opérationnel en négatif. Citation: "In addition, dispositions may result in significant asset impairment charges, including those related to goodwill"
risks.summary: LyondellBasell a enregistré des charges de dépréciation hors trésorerie substantielles de 1 251 M$ en 2025 sur les segments des polymères européens et avancés, reflétant le repli prolongé des industries pétrochimique et automobile, combiné à une baisse soutenue de la capitalisation boursière.
risks.summary_en: LyondellBasell recorded substantial non-cash impairment charges of 1,251M$ in 2025 across European and advanced polymer segments, reflecting the prolonged downturn in petrochemical and automotive industries, combined with sustained market capitalization decline.
risks.score_rationale_en: In Q3 2025, the company recognized 1,182M$ in non-cash impairments (972M$ goodwill + 279M$ PP&E) in O&P-EAI and APS segments due to prolonged industry downturn and sustained decline in market capitalization. These charges directly turned operating income negative.

risks.title: Concurrence des importations et pression sur les marges
risks.score_rationale: Documenté en MD&A comme facteur déterminant des segments O&P-EAI et O&P-Americas, avec mention spécifique de la concurrence des importations en O&P-EAI réduisant les marges polymères. L'impact est quantifiable mais non catastrophique, d'où une sévérité modérée. Citation: "Any such reductions may increase competition for product sales within Europe and other markets, which"
risks.summary: La concurrence des importations et des marchés bien approvisionnés compriment les marges sur les segments polyéthylène et polyoléfines, affectant particulièrement les unités O&P-Americas et O&P-EAI.
risks.summary_en: Import competition and well-supplied markets are compressing margins in polyethylene and polyolefins segments, particularly affecting the O&P-Americas and O&P-EAI business units.
risks.score_rationale_en: Documented in MD&A as driving factor in O&P-EAI and O&P-Americas segments, with specific mention of import competition in O&P-EAI reducing polymer margins. Impact is quantifiable but non-catastrophic, hence moderate severity.

risks.title: Perte attendue sur la cession des actifs européens oléfines et polyoléfines
risks.score_rationale: Annoncée en 2025 avec clôture attendue au T2 2026, la société comptabilisera une perte d'environ 700-900 M$ sur la cession des actifs O&P européens, incluant 300 M$ de contribution en cash. Cette perte exceptionnelle significative impacte la valeur actionnariale de manière notable. Citation: "In 2025, we agreed to sell certain European olefins and polyolefins assets and the associated"
risks.summary: LyondellBasell a accepté de céder certains actifs et activités européens oléfines et polyoléfines, avec une perte attendue de 700-900 M$ lors de la clôture au T2 2026, incluant une contribution en cash de 300 M$ avant la clôture.
risks.title_en: Expected loss on sale of European olefins and polyolefins assets
risks.summary_en: LyondellBasell agreed to sell certain European olefins and polyolefins assets and business, with an expected loss of 700-900M$ upon closing in Q2 2026, including a 300M$ cash contribution prior to closing.
risks.score_rationale_en: Announced in 2025 with expected close Q2 2026, the company will recognize a loss of approximately 700-900M$ on the sale of European O&P assets, including 300M$ cash contribution. This material non-recurring loss impacts shareholder value significantly.

risks.title: Volatilité des coûts d'intrants et d'énergie
risks.score_rationale: Le MD&A note que les coûts d'intrants et d'énergie représentent environ 70% des coûts totaux des ventes. Bien que 2025 ait bénéficié de coûts plus faibles (contribuant à la baisse des coûts), une volatilité future pourrait inverser ces gains. Citation: "In the past, raw material and energy costs have experienced significant fluctuations that adversely affected"
risks.summary: Les fluctuations des coûts d'intrants et d'énergie, qui représentent environ 70% des coûts annuels des ventes, créent une volatilité de la rentabilité et constituent une variable opérationnelle significative hors du contrôle de la société.
risks.title_en: Volatility in feedstock and energy costs
risks.summary_en: Fluctuations in feedstock and energy costs, which represent approximately 70% of annual cost of sales, create volatility in profitability and are a significant operational variable beyond company control.
risks.score_rationale_en: MD&A notes feedstock and energy costs represent approximately 70% of total cost of sales. While 2025 benefited from lower feedstock and energy costs (contributing to COGS reduction), future volatility could reverse these gains.
